title: 第九章仙灵锻体功第十章宗门大比

;;
他看着秦枫身上那远比同阶修士凝练、狂暴得多的雷电之力，心中再次掀起惊涛骇浪：“你这《雷遁术》，已经修炼到第几层了？”
秦枫老实回答：“第一层，大圆满。”
“第一层？！”老祖几乎要跳起来，“怎么会这么强？！”
秦枫挠了挠头，有些不确定地说道：“我不知道啊……难道和原本的不一样吗？我只是觉得，风雨雷电皆生于五行，我以五行为基，催动《雷遁术》，感觉灵力运转得更流畅一些，就稍稍改动了一下。”
“稍稍改动了一下……”老祖只觉得耳边仿佛又炸响了一道惊雷，震得他头晕目眩。
他再次运转神识，仔仔细细地探查秦枫体内《雷遁术》的运行路线。片刻之后，他脸上的震惊渐渐褪去，取而代之的是一种难以言喻的喜悦和欣慰。
秦枫对功法的改动，不仅没有出错，反而完美地契合了他的五行灵根，让《雷遁术》的威力发挥到了一个不可思议的地步！
“好小子，好小子！”老祖哈哈大笑起来，拍了拍秦枫的肩膀，“你这悟性，真是旷古烁今！”
笑过之后，他的表情又变得严肃起来，语气凝重地说道：“小枫，你有没有发现，你每修炼一层，消耗的资源，是他人的几十倍？”
秦枫点点头，有些担忧地问道：“是啊，老祖，我是不是太浪费了？”
老祖微微一笑，解释道：“你还记得小时候的药浴吗？”
秦枫点点头。
“那并非普通的药浴，而是我耗费几百年心血研究出的一门秘术。”老祖眼中闪过一丝追忆，“通过那药浴，可以将修士的丹田扩张五倍有余。”老祖顿了顿，目光落在秦枫身上：“你天生六灵根，经过这些年的药浴，你的丹田，已经是同阶修士的三十倍左右！”
秦枫恍然大悟，随即又皱起了眉头：“那为什么我的修炼速度，只比中品灵根快一点？”
“原因很简单。”老祖说道，“你的丹田太大了，需要的灵力也远远超过同阶修士。你虽是五行满灵根，但庞大的丹田，将你的修炼速度拉平到了中品灵根的水平。更何况，你的雷灵根只是中品，而六灵根又必须同时成长，这就更拖慢了你的速度。”
他话锋一转，语气中带着一丝自豪：“但这也有一个巨大的好处——同阶之中，你的灵力储量，是别人的三十倍！也就是说，你的战力，理论上也可以达到同阶的三十倍！”
秦枫眼睛一亮，心中的郁闷顿时一扫而空。
老祖却没有就此打住，他的表情变得前所未有的严肃：“不过，这也伴随着巨大的风险。你的肉身、丹田、经脉，必须也达到同阶的三十倍强度，否则，一旦灵力暴涨，你就会爆体而亡！”
秦枫脸上的笑容瞬间僵住，被这突如其来的“反话”震得合不拢嘴。

他……竟然成了一个随时可能爆炸的“炸弹”？
老祖看着他那副震惊的表情，心中不由得生出一丝得意。他摸了摸胡须，慢悠悠地说道：“小枫啊，老祖为了你，可是拼了老命了。”
他的眼神变得悠远，仿佛透过时光，看到了那些血雨腥风的岁月。
“为了给你寻找合适的锻体之法，老祖我一人独闯真灵族，单枪匹马入神国，一骑绝尘闯魔域……历经九死一生，终于集齐了真灵、神族、魔族、仙族最顶尖的锻体之法，取其精华，去其糟粕，独创了这一门——《仙灵锻体功》！”
说到这里，他的声音中充满了自信与骄傲：“这《仙灵锻体功》，乃是绝世神术，共分九层。只要你能修炼成功，你的肉身、丹田、经脉，都将远超同阶，足以支撑你那庞大的灵力！”
他一翻手，取出一枚通体晶莹的玉简：“这便是《仙灵锻体功》的第一层——《铜皮铁骨劲》。修炼成功后，你的肉身强度，将堪比极品法器！”
秦枫先是一惊，随即心中涌起一股难以言喻的感动与喜悦。他郑重地接过玉简，双膝跪地，对着老祖恭恭敬敬地磕了三个头：“弟子秦枫，谢老祖大恩！”
老祖哈哈大笑，伸手将他扶起：“起来吧。你先去见见你的父母和兄长，调整好心态。等你准备好了，就来我这里。我会为你准备好接下来修炼所需的丹药和浴液。”
秦枫点点头，转身离去。
他一个闪身，施展雷遁术，瞬间出现在晨露苑的上空。
晨露苑依旧是记忆中的模样，竹篱环绕，菜畦整齐，空气中弥漫着淡淡的泥土和灵草的清香。只是，菜畦旁那两个熟悉的身影，似乎比记忆中苍老了许多。
瑞安王和王妃正在菜地里劳作，他们的鬓角已经染上了白霜，背影也不再挺拔。

He looked at Qin Feng's lightning power, which was far more concentrated and violent than that of monks of the same level, and his heart stirred up a storm again: "How far has your "Thunder Escape Technique" reached?"
Qin Feng answered honestly: "The first level, Dzogchen."
"First level?!" The ancestor almost jumped up, "How can it be so strong?!"
Qin Feng scratched his head and said with some uncertainty: "I don't know... Is it different from the original one? I just think that wind, rain, thunder and lightning are all born from the five elements. I used the five elements to activate the "Thunder Escape Technique". I felt that the spiritual power was running more smoothly, so I made a slight change."
"A slight change..." The ancestor felt as if another thunder exploded in his ears, making him dizzy.
He used his spiritual consciousness again to carefully explore the route of the "Thunder Escape Technique" in Qin Feng's body. After a while, the shock on his face gradually faded away, replaced by an indescribable joy and relief.
Qin Feng's changes to the technique not only made no mistakes, but perfectly matched his Five Elements Spiritual Roots, allowing the power of "Thunder Escape Technique" to reach an incredible level!
"Good boy, good boy!" The ancestor laughed loudly and patted Qin Feng on the shoulder, "Your understanding is truly unprecedented!"
After laughing, his expression became serious again, and he said in a solemn tone: "Xiao Feng, have you noticed that for each level of cultivation, you consume dozens of times more resources than others?"
Qin Feng nodded and asked with some worry: "Yes, ancestor, am I too wasteful?"
The ancestor smiled slightly and explained: "Do you still remember the medicinal bath when you were a child?"
Qin Feng nodded.
"That is not an ordinary medicinal bath, but a secret technique that I have spent hundreds of years researching." A flash of memory flashed in the ancestor's eyes, "Through that medicinal bath, the monk's Dantian can be expanded more than five times." The ancestor paused, and his eyes fell on Qin Feng: "You are born with six spiritual roots. After these years of medicinal bath, your Dantian is already about thirty times that of a monk of the same level!"
Qin Feng suddenly realized, and then frowned: "Then why is my cultivation speed only a little faster than the middle-grade spiritual root?"
"The reason is very simple." The ancestor said, "Your Dantian is too big, and the spiritual power required is far more than that of a monk of the same level. Although you have five elements of spiritual roots, your huge Dantian has flattened your cultivation speed to the level of a middle-grade spiritual root. What's more, your Thunder Spiritual Root is only a middle-grade one, and the six spiritual roots must grow at the same time, which slows down your speed even more."
He changed the subject, with a hint of pride in his tone: "But there is also a huge benefit - your spiritual power reserve is thirty times that of others at the same level! In other words, your combat power can theoretically reach thirty times that of the same level!"
Qin Feng's eyes lit up, and the depression in his heart suddenly disappeared.
The ancestor did not stop there. His expression became more serious than ever before: "However, this also comes with huge risks. Your physical body, Dantian, and meridians must also reach thirty times the strength of the same level, otherwise, once your spiritual power surges, you will explode and die!"
The smile on Qin Feng's face froze instantly, and he was shocked from ear to ear by this sudden "irony".
He... turned out to be a "bomb" that could explode at any time?
The ancestor looked at his shocked expression and couldn't help but feel a little proud in his heart. He touched his beard and said slowly: "Xiao Feng, my ancestor risked his life for you."
His eyes became distant, as if he had seen those bloody years through time.
"In order to find a suitable body-forging method for you, my ancestor and I broke into the True Spirit Clan alone, entered the Kingdom of God alone, and rode into the Demon Realm on Juechen... After nine deaths, I finally gathered the top body-forging methods from the True Spirits, Gods, Demons, and Immortals, and took the essence and discarded the dross.He has created this unique discipline - "Fairy Spirit Body Strengthening Technique"! "
Speaking of this, his voice was full of confidence and pride: "This "Immortal Spirit Body Strengthening Technique" is a peerless magical technique, divided into nine levels. As long as you can cultivate successfully, your physical body, Dantian, and meridians will be far superior to the same level, enough to support your huge spiritual power! "
He turned over his hand and took out a crystal-clear jade slip: "This is the first level of the "Fairy Spirit Body Forging Technique" - "Copper Skin Iron Bone Strength". After successful cultivation, your physical strength will be comparable to the best magical weapons! "
Qin Feng was startled at first, and then he felt an indescribable touch and joy in his heart. He solemnly took the jade slip, knelt on his knees, and respectfully kowtowed three times to the ancestor: "Disciple Qin Feng, thank you for your great kindness! "
The ancestor laughed and stretched out his hand to help him up: "Get up. You go meet your parents and brother first and adjust your mentality. When you are ready, come to me. I will prepare the elixirs and baths needed for your next practice. "
Qin Feng nodded, turned and left.
He dodged, used the Thunder Escape Technique, and instantly appeared in the sky above Chenlu Garden.
Chenlu Garden is still the same as in memory, surrounded by bamboo fences, neat vegetable beds, and the air is filled with the faint fragrance of soil and spiritual grass. However, the two familiar figures beside the vegetable patch seemed much older than in memory.
King Ruian and his wife were working in the vegetable field. Their temples were stained with white frost and their backs were no longer straight.
